_doc: Stream E (play-test 4, S5: 'more random events: some give treasure chests (loot window like corpses), others give quests (deliver items to town, etc.)'). Small events stream A's js/sim/roadevents.js drops near a lone player in the wilds every few minutes. `rules`: firstSec = the first one after entering the wilds; gapSec = the wait between two for the same player; spawnM = how far from the player; quietM = no new event when one is already this close; lifeSec = an event nobody touched packs up after this; maxPerRoom = at most this many at once in one wilds copy. `weights` = how often each kind. CHESTS (`chests`): a lootable box opened in the SAME loot window as a corpse (each player who opens it gets their own share, rolled at the event's level with `tier`); `guards` [min,max] monsters of the nearest camp's type stand round it and the box stays shut until they are down. QUESTS: `deliver` (a stranded courier hands you a parcel for a named NPC in the nearest town), `escort` (a traveller follows you to the nearest town; ambushes on the way), `rescue` (a captive at a guarded spot: kill the guards, free them, bring them home). Quest events pay themselves when done (no walk back). `{name}` = the NPC's name, `{town}` = the town, `{npc}` = the delivery NPC, `{role}` = their trade, `{guards}` = what guards them. Rewards: `xp` = share of a level, `gold` x a kill's gold at the event's level, `item.tier` an extra roll. INFO (play-test 5 T12, tools/content-events.mjs): every chest and every deliver / escort / rescue variant carries `info` = { name, what (one sentence), objective { kind, text, count, unit }, durationSec, onSuccess, onFail, rewardText } with the same {name} {town} {npc} {guards} slots as the rest of the record; `coded` holds the info of kinds the server starts from code (the escort `ambush`). Never edit `info` by hand: change the words in the tool and re-run it. W24 (owner feedback 8, report #45: "I killed the bandits before the rats and it would not let me open the chest; then it said Won and the chest disappeared"): `rules.chest` — a chest is locked by ITS OWN guards and nothing else (`lockedBy: ownGuards`: only the bodies this event spawned count, whatever else is standing near and in whatever order things die); it opens the moment the last of them is down, and also when none of them has been in a fight for `stuckSec` (a guard that wandered off or reset must never keep a box shut); once open it STAYS until everyone who took part has emptied their share or `lootSec` seconds have passed, and the event only ends (won) after that; guards never walk more than `guardLeashM` from the box. A guarded chest NAMES its keepers: `guardTypes` = the monster types spawned as its guards at the event level (smugglers are brigands wherever the box lands), or `guardFrom: nearestCamp` with `guardFamily` to say what kind of thing may guard it (the dead mule is watched by a beast, never by brigands); `guardWord` = what the objective calls them.

chests.name: Wrecked Cart
chests.blurb: A cart on its side, a wheel gone. Someone left in a hurry.

info.name: Wrecked Cart
info.what: A cart lies on its side by the road with its load still under the canvas.
info.onSuccess: You take what the carter left behind.
info.onFail: Somebody else got to the cart first.
info.rewardText: A chest for everyone who opens it: uncommon loot or better, rolled at your level

chests.name: Buried Cache
chests.blurb: Fresh-turned earth and the corner of a strongbox.

info.name: Buried Cache
info.what: Somebody has buried a strongbox here, and not very well.
info.onFail: Whoever buried the cache came back for it.
info.rewardText: A chest for everyone who opens it: common loot or better, rolled at your level

chests.name: Smugglers' Stash
chests.blurb: Iron-bound and padlocked, with its keepers still sitting on it.

info.name: Smugglers' Stash
info.what: Smugglers are sitting on an iron-bound chest just off the road.

objective.text: Defeat the smugglers, then open their stash

info.onSuccess: The smugglers are out of business and their stash is open.
info.onFail: The smugglers pack up and move the stash.
info.rewardText: A chest for everyone who opens it: rare loot or better, rolled at your level

chests.name: Fallen Pack Mule's Load
chests.blurb: Saddlebags spilled across the grass. Something ate the mule.

info.name: Fallen Pack Mule's Load
info.what: A pack mule lies dead in the grass, and what killed it is still close by.

objective.text: Kill what ate the mule, then search the saddlebags

info.onSuccess: The saddlebags are yours, and the mule is avenged.
info.onFail: The scavengers drag the saddlebags away.
info.rewardText: A chest for everyone who opens it: uncommon loot or better, rolled at your level

chests.name: Hollow Stump Hoard
chests.blurb: A dry stump stuffed with a poacher's savings.

info.name: Hollow Stump Hoard
info.what: A dry stump by the road has a poacher's savings stuffed inside it.
info.onSuccess: The poacher will have to start saving again.
info.onFail: The poacher came back and emptied the stump.
info.rewardText: A chest for everyone who opens it: common loot or better, rolled at your level

chests.name: Stolen Toll Strongbox
chests.blurb: The Hollin toll box, prised open and abandoned by the ones who took it — or not abandoned.

info.name: Stolen Toll Strongbox
info.what: The stolen Hollin toll box sits prised open here, with the thieves still beside it.

objective.text: Defeat the thieves, then open the toll strongbox

info.onSuccess: The thieves are down and the toll box is yours.
info.onFail: The thieves carry the strongbox off into the hills.
info.rewardText: A chest for everyone who opens it: rare loot or better, rolled at your level

chests.name: Pilgrims' Offering Box
chests.blurb: A wayside offering box, its lid still sealed with wax.

info.name: Pilgrims' Offering Box
info.what: A sealed offering box stands by the wayside, and something may be watching it.

objective.text: Deal with anything guarding it, then open the offering box

info.onSuccess: The offerings go to a good cause, namely you.
info.onFail: A pilgrim collects the box and carries it on to the shrine.
info.rewardText: A chest for everyone who opens it: uncommon loot or better, rolled at your level

deliver.name: {first}, Courier
deliver.say: My horse threw a shoe and the post won't wait. Take this to {npc} in {town}? They'll make it worth your while.
deliver.title: A Parcel for {town}
deliver.text: Carry the courier's sealed parcel to {npc} the {role} in {town}.

info.name: A Parcel for {town}
info.what: A courier with a lame horse needs a parcel carried to {town}.

objective.text: Carry the sealed parcel to {npc} in {town}

info.onSuccess: {npc} has the parcel, and the post was only slightly late.
info.onFail: The courier gave up waiting and limped on with the parcel.
info.rewardText: Gold and a little experience, paid on the spot

deliver.name: {first} the Drover
deliver.say: Fever's got me and the herd won't move itself. This letter is for {npc} in {town} — please.
deliver.title: The Drover's Letter
deliver.text: Bring the drover's letter to {npc} the {role} in {town}.

info.name: The Drover's Letter
info.what: A feverish drover needs a letter taken to {town}.

objective.text: Bring the drover's letter to {npc} in {town}

info.onFail: The drover found someone else to carry the letter.
info.rewardText: Gold and a little experience, paid on the spot

deliver.name: Old {first}
deliver.say: These roots go bad by sundown. {npc} in {town} pays for them. My knees don't.
deliver.title: Roots Before Sundown
deliver.text: Take the herbalist's roots to {npc} the {role} in {town} while they're fresh.

info.name: Roots Before Sundown
info.what: An old herbalist has roots that must reach {town} before they spoil.

objective.text: Take the wet roots to {npc} in {town}

info.onSuccess: {npc} has the roots, still fresh enough to sell.
info.rewardText: Gold and a little experience, paid on the spot

deliver.name: {first} the Tinker
deliver.say: Mended this lock for {npc} in {town}, then got turned round in the hills. Save me the walk?
deliver.title: The Mended Lock
deliver.text: Return the tinker's mended lock to {npc} the {role} in {town}.

info.name: The Mended Lock
info.what: A tinker who lost the way needs a mended lock returned to {town}.

objective.text: Return the mended lock to {npc} in {town}

info.onFail: The tinker found the road again and went on alone.
info.rewardText: Gold and a little experience, paid on the spot

escort.name: {first}, Lost
escort.say: I followed the geese and now I don't know where home is. {town}? Is it far?
escort.title: Home to {town}

info.name: Home to {town}
info.what: A lost child is asking the way home to {town}.
info.rewardText: Gold and a good share of experience, paid on the spot

escort.name: {first} the Pedlar
escort.say: Things in the grass have been following me all morning. Walk with me to {town}?
escort.title: Company on the Road
escort.text: Walk {name} to {town} — something has been following them.

info.name: Company on the Road
info.what: A pedlar who is being followed wants company on the road to {town}.
info.onSuccess: {name} reached {town} with every pot and pin.
info.onFail: {name} lost patience and went on alone.
info.rewardText: Gold and a good share of experience, paid on the spot

escort.name: Brother {first}
escort.say: My guide ran when the howling started. I am bound for {town}; lend me your arm?
escort.title: The Blind Pilgrim

info.name: The Blind Pilgrim
info.what: A blind pilgrim whose guide ran off needs an arm to {town}.
info.onFail: {name} sat down to wait for a steadier guide.
info.rewardText: Gold and a good share of experience, paid on the spot

rescue.name: {first} {family}, Trader
rescue.say: They took the mules and left me tied for later. Cut me loose when they're dealt with!
rescue.title: Cut Loose
rescue.text: Deal with the {guards} holding {name}, free them, and bring them home to {town}.

info.name: Cut Loose
info.what: A trader is tied up here with the {guards} that robbed them standing guard.

objective.text: Defeat the {guards}, free {name} and bring them home to {town}

info.onSuccess: {name} is home in {town}, short a few mules.
info.onFail: The {guards} moved on and took {name} with them.
info.rewardText: Gold, a good share of experience and an uncommon item or better, paid on the spot

rescue.name: {first}, Scout
rescue.say: Don't stand there gawping — the key's on one of these brutes.
rescue.title: The Caged Scout
rescue.text: Beat the {guards}, open the cage and see {name} back to {town}.

info.name: The Caged Scout
info.what: A scout sits in a cage with the key on one of the {guards} around it.

objective.text: Beat the {guards}, open the cage and see {name} back to {town}

info.onSuccess: {name} is out of the cage and back in {town}.
info.onFail: The {guards} moved the cage, with {name} still in it.
info.rewardText: Gold, a good share of experience and an uncommon item or better, paid on the spot

rescue.name: {first} the Miller
rescue.say: Please — my family in {town} think I'm dead.
rescue.title: The Miller's Way Home
rescue.text: Free {name} from the {guards} and walk them home to {town}.

info.name: The Miller's Way Home
info.what: A miller taken on the road is being held here by {guards}.

objective.text: Free {name} from the {guards} and walk them home to {town}

info.onSuccess: {name} is home, and very much not dead.
info.onFail: The {guards} moved on and took {name} with them.
info.rewardText: Gold and a good share of experience, paid on the spot

thanks: Bless you. I'll stand you a drink in {town}.
I owe you more than coin.
Safe at last. Go well, friend.

ambush._doc: js/sim/roadevents.js ambush(): monsters of the nearest camp jump an escort every rules.ambushEveryM metres walked, at most rules.maxAmbush times. objective.count is a wave; the reward is the escort's own.

info.name: Ambush on the Road
info.what: Something has been following the one you are escorting, and it has just caught up.

objective.text: Kill the ambushers before they reach {name}

info.onFail: {name} was struck down on the road.
info.rewardText: Nothing of its own: it counts toward the escort you are on
